pages.title: Aquamirae and the Ice Maze
pages.text: **Aquamirae** adds a frozen ocean region called the **Ice Maze**: pirate ships and outposts, shelters, and shipwrecks locked in ice, with their own creatures. Fragmentum, a library mod, and GeckoLib sit underneath it.

The Ice Maze has three bosses. The **Shell Horn** summons the Ghost of Captain Cornelia near water in the Ice Maze. The Maze Mother lives deeper in. The Shipbreaker is a leviathan; its Ship Graveyard Echo leaves a trace that the Echo Compass can follow.

pages.title: Shell Horn
pages.text: Found in frozen pirate ships. Summons Captain Cornelia when used near water in the Ice Maze.

pages.title: Frozen Key
pages.text: Dropped by Cornelia. Opens a hidden chest in the depths of the Ice Maze.

pages.title: Tidepiercer
pages.text: Cornelia's weapon, looted from her after the fight.

pages.title: Echo Compass
pages.text: Points toward the nearest Ship Graveyard Echo.

**Salvager armor** supplies air underwater and keeps you from freezing in the Ice Maze. Two upgrade templates make better armor: the Terrible template upgrades Iron armor with a Fin, and the Abyssal template upgrades Diamond armor with Abyssal Amethyst.

pages.title: Rune of the Storm
pages.text: Found buried in the Ice Maze. Attach at a smithing table: +40%% damage, or -10%% damage taken, in cold biomes.

Its fish and drops feed straight into cooking: Spinefish, Esca, Jellyfish Jelly and Sea Stew all exist, and fit in with [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]() style meals. For a way to get there, see [#](2E5AAC)[Submarines](entry://ocean/submarines)[#](). More boss info: [#](2E5AAC)[Bosses](entry://exploration/bosses)[#]().
